# taste-skill v2, vendored

A copy of `skills/taste-skill` from
[github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill) at
commit `f624f37` (14 Oct 2026), MIT License (see `LICENSE`), by Leonxlnx.

TSRS runs its scripts (`draw.mjs`, `assets.mjs`, `inspect.mjs`) from this
folder only, never from `extensoes/`, so what runs is this reviewed copy.
`evals/` was left out. To update: copy the folder again from a newer commit,
note the commit here, and run the tests.
